item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Flights to TPA grounded due to thunderstorms: FAA
item.description: Flights to Tampa International Airport (TPA) are grounded due to thunderstorms, according to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

item.title: [WATCHLIST: officer-involved] [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Deputies responding to officer-involved shooting in Lakeland: PCSO
item.description: The Polk County Sheriff's Office (PCSO) confirmed deputies responded to an officer-involved shooting in Lakeland on Monday morning.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Blanche rescinds Trump ‘anti-weaponization’ fund, removing hurdle from attorney general nominee’s confirmation
item.description: Todd Blanche formally rescinded Trump's $1.8 billion anti-weaponization fund Sunday after Senate Republicans threatened to block his attorney general confirmation.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for Aug. 3
item.description: Here's what's driving prices as parents say back-to-school shopping costs more. Plus, early voting starts today in Hillsborough County.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Evelyn Johnson, the Queen of Fred's Market in Plant City, gets ready for her 99th birthday
item.description: Evelyn Johnson, the Queen of Fred's Market in Plant City, prepares for her 99th birthday. This unstoppable matriarch still shows up to work Monday through Friday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: School savings
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 Reporter Susan El Khoury advises shoppers to reuse supplies they already own, make a list before buying and take advantage of Florida’s back-to-school tax holiday and store discounts.
